name: Blacked Out
summary:
Where the world of living people comes into contact with the world of ghosts, reality no longer lends itself to logic and the usual course of things. Our thoughts, strong desires, true impulses can sometimes become uncontrollable. If, in order to realize his intentions, a person is ready to make a deal with the witchcraft world, he will not be the only one responsible for this mistake, but also all those who meet him on his life’s path. All these people will end up in the world of the damned, the world of the outcast and the desperate.

This story will tell you about prisoners of enchanted paintings, painted by a crazy artist and doomed them to eternal wandering between the real world and the ghostly world. When these worlds come into contact, you can talk to spirits. Each painting is unique and dangerous, since to free its spirit you need to go into the other world yourself and find the answer. Damned souls are treacherous, and the artist will protect his creations.
